description: 3DEO is a manufacturing company that specializes in metal 3D printing, utilizing proprietary Intelligent Layering technology to produce high-quality, cost-effective metal parts at scale. They serve a diverse range of industries, including medical devices, aerospace, and consumer products, offering end-to-end solutions from design to production.

Afero is an IoT platform company that provides a comprehensive and secure connectivity solution for smart devices. Their platform integrates hardware, software, and cloud services to enable rapid development, deployment, and management of connected products across various industries.

Alloy is a fintech company that offers an identity verification platform designed to help financial institutions automate and streamline their onboarding and compliance processes. Their solution uses machine learning and a wide array of data sources to verify customer identities, reduce fraud, and ensure regulatory compliance.

Alto IRA offers a self-directed IRA platform that allows individuals to invest in alternative assets such as private equity, real estate, and cryptocurrencies. The platform integrates with leading financial partners to provide a seamless, secure, and tax-advantaged investment experience, aiming to diversify portfolios beyond traditional stocks and bonds.

Assembly is an employee engagement platform that focuses on fostering recognition, collaboration, and engagement within organizations. It provides tools for employee recognition, rewards, and feedback, integrating seamlessly with existing workplace software to enhance organizational culture and improve employee satisfaction.

AutoIVF utoIVF is reimagining In Vitro Fertilization by automating the most complex and costly steps. Through advanced microfluidic technology, we make IVF more reliable, more affordable, and more accessible—bringing new possibilities to patients everywhere.

Avibra offers a mobile app providing wellness and insurance benefits, including life, accident, and disability coverage. The platform promotes healthy habits by rewarding users with insurance benefits and insights to improve their overall well-being.

Bambee provides small businesses with affordable access to dedicated HR managers who help with compliance, employee relations, and HR policy development. Their platform ensures businesses stay compliant with labor laws and maintain effective HR practices.

BuildOps provides an all-in-one cloud-based field service management software designed for commercial contractors. It features smart scheduling, dispatching, a technician-friendly mobile app, and customer and asset management tools, streamlining operations from the office to the field.

CABA Design develops sustainable, high-quality furniture brands that emphasize customization and modularity. They aim to revolutionize home furnishings by integrating community-driven designs and advanced technology.

Carro is a marketing technology platform designed to reach potential customers using influencers. The company’s platform connects social media power users around the world to collaborate and cross-promote products, brands, or services, enabling businesses to utilize social media influencers to increase their customer reach.

Comparably is a platform that provides insights into company cultures, employee experiences, and market compensation data. It allows users to anonymously share and compare workplace information, including salaries, benefits, and company reviews, to help job seekers make informed career decisions.

Coral is a mobile app designed to improve intimacy, connection, and communication within relationships. It offers guided exercises, educational content, and conversation prompts to help users enhance their sexual health and relationship satisfaction.

Coterie Insurance offers a fully digital, data-powered platform for small business insurance, providing fast and easy application processes, accurate policies, and a network of agents and brokers. Their solutions simplify the commercial insurance experience for agents, brokers, and business owners, ensuring quick, hassle-free coverage.

Digital Diagnostics is a healthcare technology company that pioneers AI-driven diagnostics to enhance accessibility, affordability, and quality of medical care. Their flagship product, LumineticsCore™, autonomously diagnoses diabetic retinopathy at the point of care, exemplifying their commitment to equitable and effective AI solutions in healthcare.

DISQO is a consumer insights platform that provides high-quality, first-party data to help businesses understand and engage their audiences better. By leveraging a proprietary survey and behavioral data network, DISQO delivers comprehensive analytics and actionable insights to drive informed decision-making and optimize marketing strategies.

DoltHub is a collaborative platform for managing version-controlled databases, enabling users to branch, merge, and collaborate on data like they would with code. It combines the functionality of a Git repository with a SQL database, allowing for efficient data management and collaboration.

DressX is a digital fashion platform that allows users to purchase and wear virtual clothing. The platform aims to reduce the environmental impact of fashion by offering digital alternatives, enabling users to enhance their online personas with digital garments that do not require physical production.

EarlyDiagnostics (EarlyDx) offers non-invasive liquid biopsy tests for early cancer detection and precision medicine. Their flagship product, CancerRadar, uses innovative blood tests to accurately detect and locate cancer, supported by their comprehensive bioinformatics solution, EarlyDx-Cloud, for diagnostic companies.

Fanaply creates and sells eco-friendly digital collectibles, offering NFTs for music, sports, and entertainment fans. Their platform allows brands, artists, and teams to engage with their audiences through unique digital assets, enhancing fan experiences and loyalty.

Fletch offers an AI-driven cybersecurity platform that helps organizations prioritize and respond to threats efficiently. By automating threat intelligence and providing tailored advice, Fletch ensures businesses can defend against the most critical cyber threats, saving time and enhancing security measures.

Fresco is a smart kitchen technology company that enhances the cooking experience through a connected app and smart appliances. Their platform offers step-by-step guided recipes, real-time cooking assistance, and seamless integration with various kitchen devices, making cooking easier and more enjoyable.

Gallant specializes in veterinary stem cell therapy, offering treatments to address the root cause of pet diseases. They provide stem cell banking services for pets, including dogs, cats, and horses, enabling future treatments for conditions like inflammation and immune-mediated diseases through regenerative medicine.

Gestalt Tech provides an AI-driven data warehouse platform purpose-built for fintechs and community lenders. By unifying disparate data into a single, decision-ready ecosystem, Gestalt enables institutions to access critical insights with greater speed, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness.

Greenfly is a digital media platform that enables organizations to easily collect, organize, and distribute user-generated content. Used by the Premier League, MLB, and other top sports organizations, Greenfly helps brands amplify their reach and engagement through authentic and timely social media campaigns.

GTXN is a platform designed to facilitate transactions in global markets, focusing on FX management, FX hedging, and liquidity in emerging markets. They collaborate with partners to provide regulated FX services and offer a streamlined network for these financial activities.

Honor Education is an edtech company dedicated to enhancing student learning experiences through personalized, data-driven insights. Their platform empowers educators with tools to track progress, identify areas for improvement, and foster a more engaging and effective educational environment.

HouseCanary is a real estate technology company that leverages advanced data analytics and machine learning to provide accurate property valuations and market insights. Their platform empowers investors, lenders, and real estate professionals with reliable data to make informed decisions and optimize their portfolios.

JOON is a flexible benefits platform that helps companies support their employees' well-being by offering customizable perks and reimbursements. By allowing employees to choose benefits that best suit their needs, JOON enhances job satisfaction and promotes a healthier, more engaged workforce.

Kin is an innovative insurance company that provides homeowners with tailored coverage through a user-friendly online platform. By utilizing advanced technology and data analysis, Kin offers affordable and comprehensive insurance solutions, ensuring a seamless and efficient experience for policyholders.

Loti specializes in safeguarding online identities using advanced facial recognition technology, offering robust protection against deep fakes, unauthorized use of faces, and privacy infringements. Loti is dedicated to ensuring the security and integrity of digital identities in an increasingly interconnected world.

MasonHub is a fulfillment technology company that provides end-to-end logistics solutions for e-commerce brands. By offering advanced inventory management, real-time tracking, and seamless integration with sales platforms, MasonHub ensures efficient and reliable delivery of products to customers.

Medal reduces the friction of extracting and sharing medical data for providers, payers, and consumers. Founded in 2015, Medal's platform securely and quickly retrieves patient records across the U.S., integrates with any electronic medical records system, and provides structured data output with medical coding concepts.

MOJO Sports provides an app designed to make youth sports coaching easier and more effective. It offers practice plans, team management tools, and the ability to score games, live stream, and save highlights, helping coaches stay organized and enhance the sports experience for kids.

NCX (Natural Capital Exchange) is a marketplace that enables landowners to monetize their land's natural resources through various programs, such as carbon credits, recreational leasing, and solar farming. Their platform helps landowners discover, compare, and enroll in income-generating programs tailored to their unique properties, promoting sustainable land use and conservation efforts.

Novel Effect offers an app that enhances storytime by adding interactive music and sound effects to children's books when read aloud. Designed to create magical reading experiences, the app responds to the reader's voice, making storytime more engaging and fun for kids and adults alike.

Olive & June is a modern nail care brand that offers high-quality, salon-grade products and tools for at-home manicures and pedicures. They aim to make nail care accessible and enjoyable, empowering individuals to achieve professional-looking results with ease.
One.Bio enhances health by adding natural fibers to food using their WholeFibers™ technology, improving nutrition without changing taste or convenience.

Ownwell Ownwell reduces property taxes for homeowners and commercial property owners by automating the appeal process. Combining technology with local expertise, the company delivers significant savings on a contingency basis, driving both customer value and scalable growth.

Paradromics is developing the next generation of brain-computer interfaces, offering the first high data rate connection between brains and computers. Their technology aims to address medical challenges with advanced technical solutions, creating a new industry standard.

Parsley Health is a holistic healthcare provider that integrates advanced primary care with personalized wellness plans to address the root causes of chronic conditions. By combining modern medicine, nutrition, and lifestyle changes, Parsley Health aims to improve overall patient health and well-being through a comprehensive and individualized approach.
Q-CTRL improves quantum technology with software that enhances the performance and reliability of quantum systems for real-world applications.

Quoherent is a cutting-edge start-up focused on developing quantum computing solutions that push the boundaries of processing power and computational efficiency. Quoherent revolutionizes industries by harnessing quantum technology to solve complex problems faster than ever before.

Red6 is a technology company specializing in augmented reality and synthetic training environments for military aviation. Their innovative solutions enhance pilot training by providing dynamic and realistic combat scenarios, significantly improving mission readiness and operational effectiveness.

Reframe Financial is an InsureTech company dedicated to helping families prepare for the financial challenges of aging by developing innovative insurance solutions. By partnering with industry leaders and leveraging advanced technology, they create a seamless and customer-friendly experience from application to benefit receipt, driven by bold thinking and a passion for improving lives.

Rize is a fintech infrastructure platform that enables fintechs, financial institutions, and brands to build and scale financial products and services with a single API. Their platform provides access to tools for opening accounts, transaction processing, card issuance, payment rails, and compliance, all integrated seamlessly via a sponsor bank.

Sidecar Health is an innovative health insurance company offering personalized, transparent plans that allow members to see any doctor and pay upfront with a Sidecar Health Visa card. By providing real-time pricing information and empowering consumers to shop for the best care, Sidecar Health helps reduce healthcare costs and enhance accessibility.

Standard Metrics is a financial collaboration platform designed to streamline communication and data sharing between venture capitalists and their portfolio companies. By providing real-time insights and automated reporting, Standard Metrics enhances transparency and efficiency in investment management.

Supergut is a health and wellness company that creates scientifically-formulated nutritional products designed to improve gut health. Their innovative approach focuses on balancing the microbiome to enhance digestion, boost energy levels, and support overall well-being.

Syntiant is advancing artificial intelligence and machine learning by bringing them from the cloud to edge devices. Their advanced chip solutions combine deep learning with semiconductor design to create ultra-low-power, high-performance neural network processors for always-on applications in battery-powered devices like smartphones, smart speakers, earbuds, hearing aids, and laptops.

Trainwell is a fitness platform that offers personalized workout plans and on-demand training sessions to help individuals achieve their fitness goals. With expert guidance and customizable routines, TrainWell caters to all fitness levels, providing a comprehensive and engaging approach to exercise.

TransCrypts is solving the inefficiency and fraud risk in record verification by automating the process on the blockchain. Its platform enables HR teams to issue secure, verifiable digital credentials while giving individuals full control of their records. Starting with employment and income verification, TransCrypts is expanding into education, healthcare, legal, and financial sectors—creating the trusted infrastructure for digital credentials across industries.

Turbine is a financial technology company focused on liquidity solutions for private assets. Utilizing industry expertise and data science, Turbine’s first product offers limited partners of venture capital and private equity funds liquidity without needing to sell their LP positions or other securities/assets.

Upwards is a childcare platform dedicated to connecting families with quality childcare providers through a user-friendly platform. Upwards aims to simplify the process of finding trusted childcare, ensuring parents have access to flexible and affordable options that suit their needs.

Ursa Major is a pioneering aerospace company that specializes in the development and manufacturing of innovative rocket engines. Their advanced propulsion technology aims to enhance the capabilities of space launch vehicles, driving the next generation of space exploration and transportation.
